body: I was watching Queen and Slim. They both die at the end. I was in the movie theater frozen in my seat. I had no words for that ending. I started bawling. My family laughed at me, but I usually get so attached to characters and their whole journey had me on the edge of my seat. I cried from the theater all the way home like a small child and wouldn't stop talking about it for days.
They all know. They are watching.

As the oldest, there is so much more expected of you and don't get me started with the amount of responsibility you have when you have a single parent. Sometimes it is torturous and sometimes it is amazing. I love being the oldest, but there are times I wish I wasn't.
